name: hotspot-to-rq
description: Choose research directions or assess experiments through a mainline-controlled workflow with bundled Academic Research Suite roles.

interface.longDescription: Bundles the Academic Research Suite role prompts needed by this workflow, while a bounded Mainline Workflow Controller enforces local evidence, context isolation, user gates, deterministic validation, and resumability.
defaultPrompt: Map research directions from my local paper notes and stop at the first user gate.
Evaluate my current experiment: continue, repair, pivot, or stop?
Refine my chosen research area into a frozen research question.
